games.name: [UPDATE] Five Nights at Freddy's 2: REIMAGINED
games.desc:
[Update Oct 18] I changed something AGAIN

Welcome to my personal take on Scott Cawthon's Five Nights at Freddy's 2. Things are definitely much different compared to last year's iteration on the franchise. Reworked map, gameplay elements, story, and animation are all present in this game. And I learned so much about game development while making it.

That being said, I'm pretty new to game development. Don't expect this game to be bug free, expect the opposite, actually. Hopefully I can learn a lot from my development on this game and translate these skills onto more creative and original projects.

I'll say it here to get it over with: This will be my LAST large scale Roblox game. No, I'm not kidding. I plan on hopefully pursuing game development in the future and will begin to make projects in Unreal Engine. I apologize if this disappoints any of you.

Original Game and Models by: Scott Cawthon
